scope: Read-only source, committed artifacts, allocator documentation and nvidia-smi; no GPU allocations, process attachment, source edits or restarts
conclusion: The resident backbone plus FIT/DEV caches and sequential small classifiers fit the logical device budget. No activation-retaining hook or seven-model accumulation was found. Live allocator fragmentation and the largest releasable contiguous segment cannot be proven from an external read-only observation.

lifecycle_evidence.finding: Backbone forward is inference_mode, use_cache=False, output_hidden_states=False and output_attentions=False; no vocabulary logits.
Captured selected features are copied to CPU FP16; pre-hooks return None and handles are removed in finally; matrix is a CPU NumPy array.
Head-discovery CUDA cache is deleted and empty_cache called at discovery end; feature extraction returns CPU arrays and calls training after FIT+DEV extraction returns.
FIT/DEV each own one FP32 GPU cache; construction copies bounded 8192-row chunks, no second full-cache normalization tensor.
Candidates run serially; optimizer only uses classifier parameters; best state is cloned to CPU; classifier and optimizer are deleted between candidates.
Prediction probabilities and NPZ exports return to CPU; training returns a JSON-compatible selection, not a GPU tensor or bank.

Backbone remains all-GPU during training and later TEST extraction. Explicit gc/empty_cache is after training before TEST, and finally after model deletion; there is no explicit extraction-to-training empty_cache.

allocator_evidence.finding: Unoccupied reserved cache is reusable by PyTorch. Failed cudaMalloc calls trigger cache flush and retry; empty_cache may help fragmentation but does not create additional logical PyTorch capacity.

bounded_risks: The FIT cache is one approximately 13.71 GiB allocation; live non-releasable split blocks could affect its allocation even though total logical capacity is sufficient.
No live allocated/reserved/inactive_split_bytes statistics were retrieved from the process, so high nvidia-smi usage is not classified as either retained activations or failure.
Classifier activations, CUDA contexts, BLAS workspaces and allocator rounding are additional to the exact parameter/cache counts; the logical remainder is approximately 24.69 GiB.

observation.note: Includes the ongoing extraction workload and reserved memory, not a measure of live training allocations.

recommendation: Continue the existing process and observe the first cache allocations/training epoch. No source change or restart is justified solely by high reserved memory.
